ports.notes: shared central lane, collects output from both assembler pairs; flows opposite to the outer lanes (south to north); pass-through to (-0.5,-2.5)

tiling_notes: The 2 outer lanes are an unbroken 6-tile pass-through from y_min to y_max carrying iron-plate south (import top, export bottom); the center lane is the same length but carries iron-gear-wheel north (import bottom, export top) - opposite flow direction from the outer lanes. Stacking copies vertically extends every lane; each copy's export row feeds the next copy's import row on the matching lane.
layout_pattern: Same 'raw material outside, product inside' shape as layouts/smelter_module_ports.md's 'Plate on the inside' furnace pattern, generalized past furnaces to an assembling-machine module: iron-plate (the sole iron-gear-wheel ingredient) arrives via the 2 outer lanes, iron-gear-wheel (the product) leaves via the shared center lane.
